title: Chevening Scholarship
official_source: Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO), UK
description: Chevening Scholarships allow exceptional individuals to study for a one-year master’s degree at a UK university.

title: Australia Awards Scholarships
official_source: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), Australian Government
duration: Minimum period necessary to complete the specified academic program plus any preparatory training
description: Australia Awards Scholarships are long-term awards administered by Australia's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade for people from developing countries, particularly in the Indo-Pacific, to study full time at participating Australian universities and TAFE institutions. Benefits generally include full tuition fees, return airfare, an establishment allowance, a fortnightly living-expense contribution, health cover and the Introductory Academic Program. Applicants must sign a contract with the Commonwealth and leave Australia for two years after completing the award or repay the cost.

title: Netherlands Fellowship Programme (NFP/OTS)

title: Swedish Institute Scholarship
program_type: Government scholarship (Swedish Institute public agency), master's level
duration: One- or two-year full-time master's programme
description: The Swedish Institute, a Swedish government agency, awards fully funded scholarships for master's studies in Sweden to global professionals from 34 eligible countries. The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals covers full tuition fees, a monthly living-expense allowance of SEK 12,000 and a one-time travel grant, and runs once a year for master's studies starting in the autumn semester. The Swedish Institute also runs the Pioneering Women in STEM scholarship, awarded through the same single application. title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
program_type: Government scholarship for international students (China Scholarship Council)
duration: Funded for the length of the enrolled programme; the 2026/2027 award covers only academic year 2026/2027 - any period beyond must be covered by the host university.
description: The Chinese Government Scholarship is a MOE/CSC state scholarship that funds international students to study at designated Chinese universities; it is administered by the China Scholarship Council and promoted through its official portals campuschina.org and studyinchina.csc.edu.cn.

title: Taiwan Scholarship Program
official_source: Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan)
program_type: Government scholarship (Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan))
duration: 4 years for a bachelor's programme, 2 years for a master's programme, 4 years for a doctoral programme; total scholarship period cannot exceed five years
description: The Taiwan Scholarship Program is administered by the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China (Taiwan) for outstanding foreign students, and is distinct from the MOFA Taiwan Scholarship and the MOE Huayu Enrichment Scholarship. It pays tuition and miscellaneous expenses up to NTD 40,000 each semester and a monthly living allowance of NTD 15,000 for bachelor's students and NTD 20,000 for master's and doctoral students.
